attributes.name: u-on
attributes.description: Calls an action on a DOM event: `u-on:click="save"`, or with arguments as JSON literals, `u-on:click='move(1, "left")'` (strings in double quotes, so single-quote the attribute).

modifiers.name: self
modifiers.description: Only when the event's target is this element, not a child.

modifiers.name: window
modifiers.description: Listens on `window`, so it fires wherever the event happens: `u-on:keydown.window.escape`.

modifiers.name: outside
modifiers.description: Only for events outside this element: `u-on:click.outside="close"`.

modifiers.name: Key
modifiers.description: Only for that one character's key: `u-on:keydown.ctrl.k`.

attributes.name: u-model
attributes.description: Binds an input to a `#[State]` property, both ways, as it changes. A path binds into an array: `form.email`, `todos.3.done`. On `<input type="file">` it uploads the file as soon as it's chosen.

modifiers.name: blur
modifiers.description: Writes when the field loses focus.

modifiers.name: debounce
modifiers.description: Writes after a pause in typing: 250 ms, or `.debounce.300ms`.

attributes.name: u-loading
attributes.description: Shown only while the named action or loader waits on the server: `u-loading="save"`. With no value, while anything does.

attributes.name: u-loading.remove
attributes.description: Hidden while the named action or loader waits on the server, and shown otherwise.

attributes.name: u-poll
attributes.description: Calls the action on a timer while the element is on the page: `u-poll.5s="refresh"`, every 2 s by default.

attributes.name: u-init
attributes.description: Calls the action once, when the element first appears.

attributes.name: u-key
attributes.description: Which item this element is, so re-renders keep it as a list changes: `u-key="{{ $todo['id'] }}"`.

attributes.name: u-offline
attributes.description: Shown only while the browser is offline.

attributes.name: u-confirm
attributes.description: With a `u-on` on the same element: asks this first, and does nothing if the answer is no.

attributes.name: u-ignore
attributes.description: Re-renders leave this element alone, its children and its attributes. For an element other code draws in.

attributes.name: u-navigate
attributes.description: On a link: goes to the page without loading PHP again.

attributes.name: u-persist
attributes.description: Kept exactly as it is across `u-navigate` page changes, where the next page has the same id: `u-persist="player"`.
